rules.title: Relocation assistance and Declaration of Intent to Evict required for no-fault evictions (RSO & JCO)
rules.requirement: Before any no-fault eviction from an RSO- or JCO-covered unit, the landlord must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD and pay relocation assistance per unit within 15 days of serving the termination notice, or deposit it in escrow within that period. Failure to file makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO.
rules.key_value: Jul 1, 2026–Jun 30, 2027: Eligible $11,000 (<3 yrs) / $14,400 (3+ yrs or low income); Qualified $23,150 / $27,400; adjusted every July 1
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or Just Cause Ordinance (JCO) where the tenant is evicted for a no-fault reason. Higher amounts for qualified tenants (62+, disabled, or with minor dependent children) and for tenants with 3+ years or income at or below 80% AMI.
rules.exemptions: No relocation owed when replacing a resident manager with another resident manager, or for evictions required due to natural-disaster hazardous conditions not caused by landlord negligence; landlord may offset accumulated unpaid rent except where termination is required by a government order to vacate or for an unpermitted dwelling. Reduced amounts apply to Mom and Pop properties and natural-person-owned single-family dwellings under the JCO.

rules.title: Permitted no-fault eviction grounds under RSO and JCO
rules.requirement: No-fault evictions from RSO/JCO units are limited to the enumerated grounds. These are owner, relative, or required resident-manager occupancy; demolition, commercial conversion, or removal from rental use (Ellis Act for RSO); compliance with a government order to vacate; HUD-owned property sale; residential hotel conversion or demolition; and conversion to affordable housing.

rules.title: Termination notices must follow Declaration filing and be filed with LAHD
rules.requirement: A notice to terminate tenancy may be served only after the landlord files the Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD. A copy of the notice must be filed with LAHD no later than 3 days after service.

rules.title: Reduced relocation for Mom and Pop properties (owner/family occupancy evictions)
rules.requirement: Small landlords may pay reduced relocation for good-faith evictions for occupancy by the owner or an eligible relative. This applies only if the building has four or fewer rental units, the provision was not used in the prior three years, the landlord owns no more than four units plus one single-family home on a separate lot in the city, and the relative owns no residential property in the city.

rules.title: JCO single-family dwellings owned by natural persons: one month's rent relocation
rules.requirement: For a JCO-covered single-family dwelling owned by a natural person, no-fault relocation assistance is one month's rent in effect when the notice was served, paid as money or credit. The owner may hold the property directly, in a trust, or in an entity they control, and must own no more than four units plus one single-family home on a separate lot in Los Angeles.

rules.title: Resident Protections Ordinance: enhanced relocation for lower-income tenants displaced by demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: Owners who demolish a Protected Unit for new construction within 5 years of filing must pay lower-income households (80% AMI or below) enhanced relocation, via the standardized payment or another approved option. All tenants still receive at least the RSO/JCO amounts within 15 days, and the owner must pay the highest applicable state or city amount.

rules.exemptions: Above-low-income households receive the regular RSO/JCO amounts.
